fields.why: Duration of transmission chains (median 20 days, longest 63 days) is a measure of the outbreaks' own course, stated in the Summary and supporting the elimination claim (no sustained transmission for 12 months), so it earns continuous under section A; B listed the median among measures but not the type.
Age appears only as the composition of cases by year (counts and shares, no outcome per age group), which A's own equity_measurement says; that is a descriptor, not a stratifier.
